title: NeoUtility+
description: NeoUtility+ is an all-in-one utility plugin, designed to enhance the survival experience with practical, organized, and integrated features
body:
# NeoUtility+

**NeoUtility+** is a smart all-in-one utility plugin designed for Minecraft survival, economy, SMP and semi-vanilla servers.

Instead of turning your server into a pay-to-win experience, NeoUtility+ focuses on improving everyday gameplay with practical quality-of-life features, clean menus, useful commands and server-friendly systems.

With NeoUtility+, players can manage homes, open virtual backpacks, sort inventories, sell items, use TPA, access warps, recover death items, find biomes, protect valuable items from accidental drops and much more — all through one centralized plugin.

## Features

* Utility menu with quick access to the main systems
* Smart homes with limits by rank
* Virtual backpack system
* Safe trash GUI with undo option
* Inventory and chest sorting
* Quick sell commands
* Virtual bank with Vault economy support
* Improved TPA system
* Death chest system to protect items after death
* Biome finder with cooldowns and costs
* Player profile GUI
* Personal settings menu
* Protection against accidental item drops
* Warp system with categories
* Admin panel for staff management

## Main Commands

```txt
/util
/homes
/sethome <name>
/home <name>
/backpack
/trash
/trash undo
/sort
/chestsort
/sell hand
/sell all
/bank
/tpa <player>
/warps
/warp <name>
/profile
/settings
/deathchest
/findbiome <biome>
/utiladmin
```

## Why NeoUtility+?

NeoUtility+ replaces the need for several separate plugins such as homes, backpacks, trash, sell, TPA, warps and death chest plugins.

This helps your server by offering:

* Better performance
* Fewer plugin conflicts
* Easier configuration
* A cleaner player experience
* Consistent menus and messages
* Simple commands for everyone

## Perfect For

* Survival servers
* Economy servers
* SMP servers
* Semi-vanilla servers
* Community servers
* Minecraft 1.21.11 servers

## Goal

The goal of NeoUtility+ is to make survival gameplay smoother, smarter and more enjoyable while keeping the vanilla feeling of Minecraft.

It gives players useful tools without adding overpowered mechanics, making it ideal for balanced servers that want modern features without breaking progression.
